title: Character tester for the linearized system
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements. The associated nonadaptive tester has three query positions, queries functions on vectors of length $n^2$ over that field with values in the field, and uses a finite seed space with a probability distribution. It is chosen by whether the linearized system has a solution: when one exists, the tester is built from the affine-character tester for the direction subspace using such a solution; otherwise, it always rejects.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements
